packing.rank: 2..14 inclusive (14 = Ace). Same as RANK_VALUES / Solidity evaluator.
packing.suit: 0 = clubs, 1 = diamonds, 2 = hearts, 3 = spades. Matches SUIT_VALUES and encodeCard() in handOutcome.ts.
notes: TS PokerCard ids are '${suit}-${rank}' (e.g. spades-A); packing is only for on-chain / cross-stack vectors.
Solidity PokerHandEvaluator.evaluate(uint8[7]) scores best-of-5; higher score wins.
TS evaluateHand + compareHands decide winners; royal flush is HandRank 9 (Solidity folds royal into category 8 straight-flush with high=14 — relative order still matches).

vectors.description: Royal flush (spades A-K-Q-J-T) beats ace-high junk
Wheel straight beats ace-high junk (not a straight)
Three pair collapses to best two pair with third pair as kicker (beats KK QQ + low kicker)
Pair of fives: Ace kicker beats King kicker
Pair of Aces beats pair of Kings (same kickers)
Four of a kind beats full house
Four of a kind beats flush (category order quads > FH > flush)
